Impossible Apple Pie
By: Cindy
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 12:10am

Ingredients




Peel and slice about 6 apples (you need enough to fill a pie plate 2/3 full)
Sprinkle apples with a mixture of cinnamon and sugar
Ingredients
3/4 cup Butter
1 cup sugar
1 large beaten egg
1 cup Flour
1/2 cup walnuts or almonds (optional)

Preparation

1 Fill 9 inch pie plate 2/3 full of apples mixed with cinnamon sugar mixture (or fruit of your choice. Melt butter, and it to sugar, egg, flour and nuts. Mix well and pour over apples. Spread topping to cover apples well. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes

About


From My mom,
Eat warm with ice cream or cold!!
